findings.title: Tier-3 verdict interpretation at validationVerdict.js:544 still tells AM exhibits to 're-run with the live parity check' — impossible for AM (no public distance endpoint)

Partial fix landed in 6a25ce7 — headline now PARTIAL/MEDIUM (was VERIFIED), but interpretation prose still routes to the FM recommendation.
